procurement.pi_kit: db-tronic Raspberry Pi 5 8GB / 128GB starter kit B0CRPF47RG
procurement.camera: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 Standard, regular colour

camera_cable.type: Pi 5-compatible camera cable, 15-pin Standard to 22-pin Mini
camera_cable.routing_requirement: Total routed length must include slack for pan/tilt movement and service access

servo_labels.note: User photos confirm voltage labels; torque operating conditions, stall current and logic compatibility remain unknown. 5 V direct supply is below the marked range.

owned_dc_adapter.dc_connector_style: Barrel plug plus removable female barrel-to-two-screw-terminal adapter; photo IMG_1858; dimensions and current rating not established
owned_dc_adapter.note: Do not connect directly to 6-7.4 V servos; 10 A capacity does not raise its 5 V output. Possible pump/control source after regulation and current/connector checks. Not a verified Pi 5 USB-PD supply.

gun_assembly.switch_function: Photo suggests two-wire switch in series with positive motor supply; verify unpowered continuity before wiring

battery.final_enclosure_status: original bench source; regulated pump supply proposed instead; no battery bay designed

gun_assembly.electrical_interface: Do not connect switch contacts directly to ESP32 GPIO until circuit is identified; reserve a rated relay/MOSFET/interface
gun_assembly.measurement_quality: User exact dimensions 132.25 x 32 x 24 mm on 2026-09-28; orange housing plus nozzle only; elbow, wires, switch and battery excluded
gun_assembly.front_section_width_source: User says 18 mm; caliper photo IMG_1866 shows 18.02. IMG_1868 confirms barrel-like section; circular 18 mm model is an approximation, orthogonal thickness remains unmeasured.

owl_scan.design_role: aesthetic reference only; custom head and body permitted
owl_scan.source: User owl dimensions 18 x 39 cm; height-based scale provisional

reservoir.status: no bottle selected; user requested parametric placeholder
reservoir.shape: provisional squat round bottle, not a measured commercial product
reservoir.placement: stationary lower body; never on pan/tilt
reservoir.notes: Nominal capacity is independent of placeholder dimensions. Replace dimensions after bottle selection. Cap fittings, vent, dip tube, leak tray and removal path are not yet engineered.

actuator_control.controller: reuse ESP32 with old camera disabled
actuator_control.servo_signals: direct hardware PWM, subject to exact servo 3.3V signal compatibility
actuator_control.servo_power: separate regulated supply within confirmed 6-7.4 V label range; current sizing pending; owned 5 V adapter is not suitable directly; not Pi/ESP32 power pins
actuator_control.pump_interface: pending switch identification and voltage/current measurement
actuator_control.pi_link: USB serial proposed; existing firmware is Wi-Fi HTTP, migration not implemented

power_architecture.user_preference: one external AC adapter powering everything
power_architecture.status: requirements captured; converters, connector ratings and peak-current budget not selected
power_architecture.existing_5v_adapter_option: 5 V source would need a 6 V servo boost stage, appropriate Pi USB-C power interface, and regulated pump branch; capacity not approved
power_architecture.alternative_option: One higher-voltage external DC supply with separately regulated Pi, servo and pump branches; no supply purchased or current rating specified
power_architecture.separate_pi_adapter: available as interim bench-test source, not the preferred final architecture

pi_protective_cover.reference_cooling: Author description says designed for official active cooler
pi_protective_cover.final_choice: not selected; adapt a ventilated cover to the owl or check provided case meshes

operating_requirements.range_status: User-reported pump reach; accuracy and effective deterrence range not yet tested
